_comment: Your copilots/agents. Add a tool by copying a block. type=server gets Start/Stop/Open + a live status dot; type=chrome opens a chrome:// or web page in Chrome; type=info is just a label.

memory._comment: Cross-copilot client memory lives here — the shared-learnings the copilots/agents write as they work. The control room surfaces it per client; a richer per-client view is a later feature (this just reserves the room).

tools.name: Ads Scraper
tools.note: Runs inside Claude Code (scrape-meta-ads skill) — no local server to open. Invoke it in a Claude Code session.

tools.name: Edit Capture
tools._comment: Logs what you fix in the Uplane editor (and why) into the context graph. Pair with the uplane-edit-capture Chrome extension.

tools.name: Daily Digest
tools.note: Its own Slack app. No port — a weekday 08:00 job plus a Socket Mode chat listener, both supervised by the SwiftBar 'Daily Digest' menu item (launchd can't read ~/Desktop). DM the bot to add/change/drop items. Dry run: ./run.sh | Post now: ./run.sh --post | Chat: ./run.sh --bot | Wiring: ./run.sh --health

tools.name: Demo Agent
tools.note: Its own Slack app + own Claude login (~/.claude-demo). No port — a Socket Mode DM bot supervised by the SwiftBar 'Demo Agent' item. Stage-gated demo pipeline: DM it `help`. Setup: SETUP.md (3 manual steps). Probes: ./run.sh --probes | Listener: ./run.sh --bot
